title: Operation OpenClaw: Kill Chain Analysis of an AI Agent-Driven Cyberattack
description: Academic kill chain analysis (Lockheed Martin model) of an AI agent-driven cyberattack across 5 phases: Reconnaissance, Weaponization, Delivery and Exploitation, Lateral Movement and Persistence, Exfiltration and Double Extortion (PromptLock). Includes academic notes, M2 Sorbonne course materials on AI and Cybersecurity, and per-phase infographics. Multilingual deliverables (EN/FR/PT).
notes: Active research project. Includes M2 Sorbonne course slides on AI and Cybersecurity (versions 5-8). Per-phase reports ~25-30 pages each.
